description: This file defines a test fixture class 'LDAPUsersFixture' used for setting up, managing, and cleaning LDAP directory entries for testing purposes within the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods to create and delete organizational units, users, and groups in an LDAP directory, as well as utility functions to handle LDAP queries and exceptions.

classes.name: LDAPUsersFixture
classes.description: A test fixture class for LDAP directory setup and cleanup in unit tests, managing LDAP organizational units, users, and groups.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Initializes LDAP directory structure with predefined users and groups.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Removes LDAP entries created by load(), cleaning up the directory.

methods.name: searchAndDelete
methods.description: Searches for LDAP entries based on distinguished name and filter, then deletes found entries.

methods.name: removeEntity
methods.description: Removes a specific LDAP entry.

methods.name: tryWrapper
methods.description: Executes a closure and suppresses LdapException errors.

methods.name: createRootOrgUnits
methods.description: Creates the top-level LDAP organizational units 'users' and 'groups' under 'dc=example,dc=org'.

methods.name: deleteRootOrgUnits
methods.description: Deletes root organizational units and related LDAP entries.

methods.name: createAdminOrgUnit
methods.description: Creates LDAP organizational units for admin and hr users, and adds sample admin users.

methods.name: deleteAdminOrgUnit
methods.description: Removes the admin and HR organizational units and associated entries.

methods.name: createSalesOrgUnit
methods.description: Creates LDAP organizational units for sales, marketing, and client services, and adds sample users.

methods.name: deleteSalesOrgUnit
methods.description: Deletes sales-related LDAP organizational units and entries.

methods.name: createLegalOrgUnit
methods.description: Creates an LDAP organizational unit for legal department.

methods.name: deleteLegalOrgUnit
methods.description: Deletes the legal LDAP organizational unit.

methods.name: createEngineeringOrgUnit
methods.description: Creates LDAP organizational units for engineering, including developers, managers, QA, and sample users.

methods.name: deleteEngineeringOrgUnit
methods.description: Removes engineering organizational units and entries.

methods.name: createFinanceOrgUnit
methods.description: Creates LDAP organizational unit for finance and adds sample users.

methods.name: deleteFinanceOrgUnit
methods.description: Deletes the finance organizational unit.

methods.name: createAdminsGroup
methods.description: Creates LDAP group 'admins' with admin users.

methods.name: deleteAdminsGroup
methods.description: Removes the 'admins' group entry.

methods.name: createManagersGroup
methods.description: Creates LDAP group 'managers' with managerial users.

methods.name: deleteManagersGroup
methods.description: Removes the 'managers' group entry.

methods.name: createEmployeesGroup
methods.description: Creates LDAP group 'employees+ou=engineering' with employee members.

methods.name: deleteEmployeesGroup
methods.description: Removes the 'employees+ou=engineering' group entry.
